compute_throughput_model: compute the throughput of a PyTorch model by running timed forward passes on random inputs
init_distributed_mode_args: initialize distributed training mode from environment variables and set up the process group
create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to track and log smoothed training metrics like loss and accuracy over iterations
create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue tracker to maintain a rolling window average, median, and global average of values
save_on_master_checkpoint: save a PyTorch checkpoint to disk only from the main process in a distributed training setup
